images.name: cloudtex_b
images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: painted cloud-bank texture, variant B. Generate ONE 1536×1024 image. IMAGE 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match the painted clouds in its lower-right canyon, their cloud rendering, palette and restrained brushwork, never its layout or other objects. The entire new image is a dense opaque bank of billowing valley cumulus seen from above at a high three-quarter angle. Clouds fill 100 percent of the image edge to edge, including every corner. Warm SUNSET light from SCREEN UPPER-LEFT: rose-peach and warm cream on lit billow tops, soft lavender and deeper dusky violet in shadowed valleys. Larger rounded heads, deep violet valleys between them, a few thin wisps over the dense opaque cloud body. Billow heads roughly 120–260 pixels wide, roughly uniform scale throughout, irregular natural arrangement with no single dominant feature. HAND-DRAWN painted 2D action-game environmental art, clean painted material planes, soft but readable cloud forms, bold jewel tones, restrained surface texture, no conspicuous grain, no photographic texture. CRITICAL: a horizontally seamless repeat texture: the LEFT and RIGHT boundaries must wrap continuously, with cloud shapes, colors, illumination and contours at the leftmost columns continuing those at the rightmost columns at every corresponding height; plan boundary-crossing billows as shared continuous shapes. Even overall brightness from top to bottom, evenly distributed illuminated heads across the whole frame, no vignette or gradient to darkness. No sky, ground, rocks, cliffs, bridge, trees, horizon, empty gaps, green background, transparency, characters, text, UI or border. This task is an opaque cloud texture, not a sprite sheet. Output only the single finished landscape texture.

references.role: Approved painted cliff and cloud look; cloud style only

concerns: Exact horizontal seam continuity remains unverified.
Some merged billow heads appear wider than the requested 120–260 px range.
